title: Adding a large twist of a relatively ample sheaf gives a very ample sheaf
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a finite type morphism over a quasi-compact base and a relatively ample invertible sheaf, tensoring any invertible sheaf with a sufficiently high power of the ample one gives a relatively very ample sheaf. The proof reduces to an affine base, uses the affine characterisation to make a suitable twist globally generated, chooses generating sections and the induced morphism to projective space, and then refines it by adding sections of higher powers of the ample sheaf, which produces the immersion required for very ampleness.
